decision.explanation: Both dates correspond to distinct albums titled "Killswitch Engage" by the same band. The second, released on June 30, 2009 (D2S2), refers to the band’s fifth studio album via Roadrunner Records. These are separate releases with the same name and are both valid answers depending on which album is referenced.
